# Card

A summary of one item with one primary link stretched over it.

- Status: implemented
- Category: container
- Pattern: HTML `<article> with a heading link`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **container**: Raised surface, subtle edge; the edge takes the accent on hover.
- **link**: The heading's link, stretched over the card.
- **meta** (optional): Tertiary label line.
- **body** (optional): Secondary text.
- **media** (optional): An image with its renditions.

## Variants

- `link`: The whole card follows its link.

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `focus-visible`: The ring around the whole card.

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | To the card's link. |
| Enter | Follows it. |

## Accessibility

- Role: article
- Name: Its heading.
- Nothing else interactive inside a stretched link.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA)
- 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) (A)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div>
  <article class="nd-card">
    <p class="nd-card__meta">Category</p>
    <h3><a class="nd-card__link" href="#card">A card heading</a></h3>
    <p class="nd-card__body">One primary link stretched over the card.</p>
  </article>
</div>
```
